result.surveyGuide: Shared floor checkpoint history since reset. rows run north-to-south, columns west-to-east: 1=checkpoint observed with line of sight, 0=unknown, x=inside a static structure and excluded from totalCells. Checkpoint center x=minX+(column+0.5)*(maxX-minX)/columns; z=minZ+(row+0.5)*(maxZ-minZ)/rows at floorCargoHeight. Only stationary observe calls credit checkpoints. These are sampled positions, not full cell area or exhaustive inventory coverage. knownCargo contains only actually observed cargo. Use the published static floorplan and clearance to choose your own collision-free waypoints; direct blocked paths are rejected. Drone look aims optics independently in world pan/tilt degrees, even during flight.
